name: Loki
description: Loki knows the art of deception. The trickster employs stealth to sabotage enemies. Sow confusion.
passiveDescription: Able to hang from walls |MULT|x longer than normal.

abilities.description: Loki deploys a holographic copy of himself that draws enemy fire and absorbs a portion of nearby enemy health and shields.
Loki camouflages himself, becoming invisible to enemies.
Loki instantaneously swaps positions with a target, confusing the enemy.
Lets forth a wave of energy, disrupting the projectile weapons of enemies in range and forcing them to revert to melee combat.
